s1.title: The service
s1.body: Learning Tracker is free and provided as it is. We don't promise that it will always be available or free of errors.

s2.title: Your content
s2.body: You own what you add, and you are responsible for it.

s3.title: Acceptable use
s3.body: Don't use the app to harm its systems or other people.

s4.title: Your data
s4.body: If your data matters to you, export it from time to time.

s5.title: Account limits
s5.body: Each account can hold up to 2,000 sources, 10,000 cards and 5,000 notes.

s6.title: Changes
s6.body: These terms can change. The date at the top of this page shows the latest update.

s1.title: What we collect
s1.body: Your email and name from your Google account, plus your sources, notes, cards, review history and settings.

s2.title: Why we use it
s2.body: Only to run the app: to store what you learn and work out your review schedule. We don't sell your data or use it for advertising.

s3.title: Where it is stored
s3.body: Your data is stored with Supabase in Singapore. The app runs on Vercel in Singapore. Sentry receives technical error reports.

s4.title: Links you add
s4.body: The app visits a link you add to read its title and image.

s5.title: Cookies and browser storage
s5.body: We use them for your session, language, appearance and ratings not yet sent. We don't use tracking cookies.

s6.title: Your rights
s6.body: You can export all of your data as JSON and delete your account in Settings. Deleting your account removes your data from the system at once, and it is gone from backups after 14 days.

legal.claudeBody: If you connect Claude or another app, it can read your sources, notes, cards and stats, add sources and notes, and propose cards. What it reads is then handled under that app's own terms. You can disconnect it in Settings.
